comment: E2E: the inspect-before-python guard makes a weak model safe. With a VAGUE prompt ('subí 10 al monto de todas las frutas'), flash used to go straight to gsheets_run_python and guess the semantics (filtering Producto by name -> 0 rows). With the guard, the first run_python is intercepted with an `inspect_first` envelope carrying a markdown preview of 'Ventas'; the agent re-calls with code using the real Categoria column and applies +10 to the 3 frutas (Manzana/Banana/Pera). Replace <SPREADSHEET_ID> with a real sheet (tab 'Ventas', column A 'Categoria' merged) per the gsheets E2E runbook (Secret Manager creds + PYTHONPATH for embedded python).

test_payload.prompt:
Use this exact spreadsheet_id (copy character-by-character): <SPREADSHEET_ID>
En la hoja 'Ventas' de esa planilla, subí 10 al monto de todas las frutas y guardá el cambio en la misma hoja. Avisame qué cambiaste.

config.system_message: Sos un asistente que trabaja con Google Sheets. Copiá el spreadsheet_id verbatim. No inventes datos.
